articles.title: Southport killer Axel Rudakubana appears to be manipulating the system, families' lawyer says
articles.description: On Thursday, Axel Rudakubana was moved from prison to a secure psychiatric hospital in Berkshire.

articles.title: Tens of thousands evacuated from French tourist spot and near Madrid as wildfires spread
articles.description: The fire has raged in the region for several days with officials now ordering the evacuation of the entire Cap Ferret peninsula.

articles.title: 'Extremely significant' bomb in car intercepted on way to NI, Irish police say

articles.title: Angela Rayner rules out rent controls in England
